payload.title: Keep detailed report artifacts off the optimization critical path
payload.description:
As an optimization operator, I want authoritative milestone decisions published before detailed artifact enrichment, so that report generation does not delay diagnosis or execution.

Feature: Core-first milestone publication

Scenario: An intermediate milestone advances
  Given decision evidence, the stakeholder workbook, and aggregate presentation are valid
  When the milestone is published
  Then the immutable core revision becomes authoritative
  And the procedure may continue before score-level and scorecard-level artifacts are generated

Scenario: Final detail enrichment fails
  Given optimizer evidence is already durable
  When final detail enrichment cannot complete
  Then optimizer evidence remains preserved
  And the run is visibly incomplete and retryable
  And the Report is not labeled complete
